13/S0.subgoal: Introduce the lecture and explain the holistic view of the VR system beyond just hardware.

13/S1.subgoal: Describe how data flows between the user and the VR hardware using stimulation and tracking.

13/S2.subgoal: Account for the role of the surrounding physical world and external objects in the comprehensive VR system.

13/S3.subgoal: Identify the three major functional components of a VR system: displays, sensors, and computers.

13/S4.subgoal: Classify and describe the first three types of hand input devices used in VR environments.

13/S5.subgoal: Describe the hand-worn and bare hand input devices, detailing their advantages and disadvantages.

13/S6.subgoal: Explain head tracking and eye tracking as non-hand-based input methods for VR.

13/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main concepts covered regarding the comprehensive view and types of VR hardware.
